title: 第25章 破境 下第26章 夜袭
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
流云峰西侧有一块灵田，种植着十几株入了品级的寒心草。寒心草是炼制筑基丹的辅料之一，价值不菲，平日里由专门的灵植弟子照料。一天夜里，照料灵田的弟子疏忽了，引水渠的闸门没关严，灵田里的水一夜之间漏了一大半。第二天一早发现的时候，十几株寒心草已经有些发蔫了。灵植弟子急得团团转，挨了一顿训斥之后赶紧去补种。
刘叙白刚好早起练剑路过那片灵田。他蹲在水渠旁边看了一会儿，发现水渠的闸门设计本身就有问题——闸门只用一块石板卡在渠口，靠石板的重量压住水流，但只要水压稍微大一点，石板就会被顶开。他想起在藏经阁看过的一本《宗门水利设施图录》，里面有一种用杠杆原理加固水闸的方法。他花了半天时间，砍了一截松木做成杠杆支架，又找了一块合适尺寸的石头当配重，把水闸改装了一下。改装之后的水闸可以根据水压自动调节闸门角度，不用人来手动开关。
灵田的管事知道之后专门来看了一趟，看完之后沉默了好一会儿，然后问刘叙白以前是干什么的。刘叙白想了半天，最后答了三个字——“搞技术的”。管事的虽然没太听明白，但觉得这个小伙子做事既肯动脑子又肯花力气，回头就跟江晴雪提了一嘴。
几件事加在一起，流云峰上下对刘叙白的看法在不知不觉中发生了变化。最初那些低声议论“山下带上来的散修”的声音渐渐少了，取而代之的是在走廊上碰到时微微点头、在藏经阁里主动让出座位、在伙房里打饭时多给几块肉。这些变化很细微，但刘叙白能感觉到。和他走在一起的陈砚最先注意到这一点——有一次两人走在石阶上，迎面过来一个外门弟子，对方居然主动朝他点了点头，说了声“刘师兄早”。陈砚被遗忘在后面，戳了戳他的后背，压低声音说了句：“叙白哥，你什么时候从散修混成师兄了？”
刘叙白没有回答，只是笑了笑。他并不在意这些虚名，但他很清楚，这些变化意味着他在流云峰不再是那个格格不入的外来者了。他在用最笨拙也最扎实的方式，一点一点地在这个大宗门里扎下根来。
就这样，将近两个月的时间过去了。
这天傍晚，刘叙白从后山回来，身上还带着练剑时沾的一身石粉。他盘腿坐在客房的床榻上，照常运转灵力。丹田里的灵力光团已经充盈到了一个临界点，他能感觉到炼气四层那道壁垒就在触手可及的位置，但始终差了一线。那感觉就像隔着一层薄薄的冰面看水底的鱼——鱼就在那里，但冰面还没破。
他闭上眼睛，把下午和苏清欢对练时的每一个细节都在脑海中回放。她的剑势、她的身法、她出剑时那种内敛到极致的力道。观剑、试剑、破剑。藏经阁那本旧手札上的三个词在他意识里反复浮现。他观了两个月的剑——不仅是苏清欢的剑，还有后山崖壁上历代剑修留下的剑痕，还有演武场上那些弟子的剑招，每一道轨迹都在他心里留下了印记。他试了无数次的剑——在崖壁前挥出的每一剑都是一次试验，每一次试验都在缩小他和那道壁垒之间的距离。现在只剩下最后一步——破。
破剑。破的不是外在的剑招，是心中的执念。他问了自己一个问题：我为什么练剑？为了活下去？为了保护身边的人？为了讨回周元纬欠陈砚的那两拳？这些都是，但都不全是。他练剑，最重要的是因为这柄剑让他在这个世界上有了一点主动选择的权利。不是被动地算计、躲避、在夹缝里蜷缩求生，而是有足够的力量站出来承担该承担的事。
剑不是武器。剑是他选择成为什么样的人的方式。
这个念头在他意识中亮起来的瞬间，丹田里的灵力光团猛地一震。他没有刻意去冲击那道壁垒，他只是想通了，然后壁垒自己就碎了。一股温热的灵力从丹田涌出，顺着经脉流向四肢百骸，平稳而有力。整个过程没有破炼气二层时破障晶催发的痛苦撕裂，也没有强行冲关的艰涩阻塞，而是一种自然而然的、水到渠成的通畅。
炼气四层。炼气中期。从散修界的标准来看，这已经是可以勉强在弱肉强食中自保的水平了。如果说炼气初期是刚学会走路的婴儿，炼气中期就是能跑能跳的少年。他的灵力质量比三层时提升了一大截，经脉宽度也进一步扩展，再使《悟道剑诀》的基础三式，威力和之前完全不可同日而语。
刘叙白睁开眼睛的时候，天色已经彻底黑了。他低头看了看自己的双手，皮肤之下那层微弱的灵光比之前更加明显了，像是有一层极薄的水银在皮肤下面缓缓流动。他握了握拳，感受着指尖涌动的力量。
他想做的第一件事不是测试新境界的威力，而是掏出手机，打开墟市查看收货架上更新了什么新东西。突破炼气四层后，筑基期的货架果然又亮起了一大片。他快速浏览了一遍新解锁的物品——筑基丹的正品赫然在列，售价五百枚下品灵石；几件筑基期才能使用的防御法器，价格从三百到八百不等；还有一本名为《剑意初解》的玉简，标价两百枚。他估算了一下自己现在手头能支配的灵石，不到四十五枚，全都来自突破炼气四层后墟市随境界提升附赠的奖励。
穷是穷了点，但墟市每一次境界突破都会解锁更强的物品，而更强意味着更多的可能性。两个月前他在青石镇用破障晶强行突破时，还是个连下一顿饭在哪里都不知道的穷光蛋。现在他在画梅宗站住了脚跟，有了稳定的修炼环境，有了随时可以请教的高手，有了正在恢复的兄弟。起点已经完全不同了。
他站起来，推开露台的木门。冷风扑面而来，带着松脂的清香。流云峰的夜色一如往常，灯火点点，剑啸隐隐。远处医舍的方向还亮着灯，陈砚大概还在做晚间的复健。更远处苏清欢院子的方向也有一星微光，那棵老梅树的花期快过了，花瓣正在一片一片地飘落。
刘叙白在露台上站了一会儿，然后转身回屋，把青鞘长剑佩在腰间，推门出去。他要去苏清欢的院子，把这个消息告诉她。
走在石阶上的时候，他习惯性地扫了一眼四周。然后他看到了一个人——一个瘦小的身影蹲在他必经的石阶旁边，缩在灵植丛的阴影里，像一片被风吹落的枯叶。那人听到脚步声，猛地抬起头，灵植丛叶片上的夜露簌簌落下，石板上洇开一小团深色的水渍。
就着月光，刘叙白看清了她的脸。是很久没见的阿木，那个给他通风报信的跑腿小厮，此刻穿着一件画梅宗外门杂役的灰布短衫，脸上全是泪痕，鼻头冻得通红，身体在夜风里发着抖。
“刘大哥——”阿木的声音沙哑得像是砂纸磨过石头，他一把抓住刘叙白的袖子，手指冰凉，力气却大得惊人，“我姐、我娘——我在画梅宗里找不到别的人，只能来求你了！”

content_en:
There is a spiritual field on the west side of Liuyun Peak, where more than a dozen Hanxin grasses that have reached the highest level are planted. Hanxincao is one of the auxiliary materials for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill. It is valuable and is usually taken care of by specialized spiritual plant disciples. One night, the disciple who was taking care of the spiritual field was negligent and the gate of the aqueduct was not tightly closed. As a result, most of the water in the spiritual field leaked overnight. When I found it early the next morning, more than a dozen cold-hearted grasses were already wilting. The disciples of Lingzhi were so anxious that they rushed to replant after being scolded.
Liu Xubai happened to get up early to practice his sword and passed by the spiritual field. He squatted next to the ditch and looked at it for a while, and found that there was a problem with the design of the gate of the ditch - the gate was only stuck at the mouth of the ditch with a stone slab, and the weight of the slab held down the water flow. But as long as the water pressure was slightly greater, the slab would be pushed open. He remembered the "Illustrated Catalog of Zongmen's Water Conservancy Facilities" he had read in the Zangjing Pavilion, which contained a method of strengthening the sluice using the lever principle. He spent half a day cutting a piece of pine wood to make a lever bracket, and found a stone of suitable size to use as a counterweight, and modified the sluice gate. The modified sluice can automatically adjust the gate angle according to water pressure, eliminating the need for humans to open and close it manually.
After Lingtian's steward found out, he made a special trip to see it. After reading it, he was silent for a while, and then asked Liu Xubai what he did before. Liu Xubai thought for a long time and finally answered in three words - "technical person". Although the person in charge didn't quite understand it, he felt that this young man was willing to use both his brain and effort to do things, so he turned around and mentioned it to Jiang Qingxue.
Several things were put together, and Liu Xubai's views on Liu Xubai changed unconsciously. The initial whispers about "casual cultivators brought up from the mountain" gradually disappeared, and were replaced by slight nods when meeting each other in the corridor, voluntarily giving up seats in the Sutra Pavilion, and giving a few extra pieces of meat when preparing meals in the kitchen. These changes are subtle, but Liu Xubai can feel them. Chen Yan, who was walking with him, was the first to notice this - one time when the two of them were walking on the stone steps, an outer disciple came towards him, and the other disciple actually nodded to him and said "Good morning, Senior Brother Liu". Chen Yan was left behind, so he poked his back and said in a low voice: "Brother Xu Bai, when did you become a senior from a casual cultivator?"
Liu Xubai didn't answer, just smiled. He didn't care about these false names, but he knew very well that these changes meant that he was no longer the incompatible outsider in Liuyun Peak. He is using the clumsiest and most solid method to take root in this large sect bit by bit.
In this way, nearly two months passed.
That evening, Liu Xubai came back from the back mountain, still carrying stone powder on his body from practicing sword practice. He sat cross-legged on the bed in the guest room, using his spiritual power as usual. The spiritual light group in his Dantian has been filled to a critical point. He can feel that the barrier on the fourth level of Qi Refining is within reach, but it is always just a hair away. It felt like looking at the fish at the bottom of the water through a thin layer of ice - the fish were there, but the ice hadn't broken yet.
He closed his eyes and replayed every detail of his afternoon sparring session with Su Qinghuan in his mind. The power of her sword, her movement, and the extremely restrained strength when she draws her sword. Observe swords, test swords, and break swords. The three words in the old manuscript in the Sutra Pavilion repeatedly appeared in his consciousness. He watched the swords for two months - not only Su Qinghuan's sword, but also the sword marks left by previous generations of swordsmen on the back mountain cliff, as well as the sword moves of the disciples on the martial arts field. Every trace left a mark on his heart. He tried the sword countless times - every sword swing in front of the cliff was a test, and every test narrowed the distance between him and the barrier. Now only the last step remains - breaking.
Broken sword. What breaks is not the external sword moves, but the obsession in the heart. He asked himself a question: Why do I practice swordsmanship? To survive? In order to protectProtect the people around you? To get back the two punches Zhou Yuanwei owed Chen Yan? These are all, but not all. The most important thing for him to practice swordsmanship is because this sword gives him a little bit of the right to make active choices in this world. It is not about passively calculating, avoiding, and huddling in the cracks to survive, but having enough strength to stand up and take on what needs to be done.
The sword is not a weapon. The sword is how he chooses to be who he is.
The moment this thought came to light in his consciousness, the spiritual light group in his Dantian shook violently. He didn't deliberately attack the barrier, he just figured it out, and then the barrier broke by itself. A warm spiritual power gushes out from the Dantian and flows along the meridians to the limbs and bones, steadily and powerfully. The whole process does not involve the painful tearing caused by the barrier-breaking crystals when breaking through the second level of Qi Refining, nor the difficult obstruction of forcibly breaking through the level, but a natural and smooth process.
The fourth level of Qi refining. The middle stage of Qi refining. Judging from the standards of the casual cultivator world, this is already a level that can barely protect itself in the jungle. If the early stage of Qi refining is a baby that has just learned to walk, the middle stage of Qi refining is a teenager who can run and jump. The quality of his spiritual power has been greatly improved compared to the third level, and the width of his meridians has been further expanded. Furthermore, the power of the three basic postures of "Enlightenment Sword Art" is completely different from before.
When Liu Xubai opened his eyes, the sky was completely dark. He looked down at his hands. The faint aura under his skin was more obvious than before, as if there was an extremely thin layer of mercury flowing slowly under his skin. He clenched his fist and felt the power surging through his fingertips.
The first thing he wanted to do was not to test the power of the new realm, but to take out his mobile phone and open the market to see what new items were on the shelves. After breaking through the fourth level of Qi Refining, the shelves in the foundation-building stage were indeed lit up again. He quickly browsed through the newly unlocked items - the genuine Foundation Establishment Pill was listed, priced at 500 low-grade spiritual stones; several defensive weapons that could only be used during the Foundation Establishment period, ranging in price from 300 to 800; and a jade slip titled "The Preliminary Understanding of Sword Intent", priced at 200. He estimated that he had less than forty-five spiritual stones at his disposal now, all of which came from the rewards in the market as his level increased after breaking through the fourth level of Qi Refining.
Being poor is a bit poor, but every breakthrough in the market will unlock stronger items, and stronger means more possibilities. When he used the barrier-breaking crystal to force a breakthrough in Qingshi Town two months ago, he was still a pauper who didn't even know where his next meal would be. Now he has established a foothold in Hua Mei Sect, has a stable training environment, has masters who can consult at any time, and has brothers who are recovering. The starting point is completely different.
He stood up and pushed open the wooden door to the terrace. The cold wind blew against my face, carrying the fragrance of rosin. The night at Liuyun Peak was as usual, with lights flickering and swords whistling faintly. There was still a light on in the direction of the hospital in the distance, and Chen Yan was probably still doing his evening rehabilitation. There was also a glimmer of light further away in the direction of Su Qinghuan's yard. The flowering period of the old plum tree was almost over, and the petals were falling one by one.
Liu Xubai stood on the terrace for a while, then turned back to the house, put the green sheath sword on his waist, and pushed the door open. He was going to Su Qinghuan's yard to tell her the news.
While walking on the stone steps, he glanced around as a habit. Then he saw a person - a thin figure squatting next to the stone steps he must pass, huddled in the shadow of the spiritual plant bush, like a dead leaf blown down by the wind. When the man heard the footsteps, he raised his head suddenly. The night dew on the leaves of the Lingzhu bush fell, and a small group of dark water stains spread on the stone slab.
In the moonlight, Liu Xubai could see her face clearly. It was Amu who he hadn't seen for a long time, the errand boy who had tipped him off. He was wearing a gray cloth blouse painted on the plum sect's outer door. His face was stained with tears, his nose was red from the cold, and his body was shivering in the night wind.
"Brother Liu——" Amu's voice was hoarse as if sandpaper had been rubbed against a stone. He grabbed Liu Xubai's sleeve, his fingers were cold but his strength was amazing, "My sister, my mother——I can't find anyone else in the Painted Plum Sect, so I can only come to beg you! "
